annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (Government Information Service), Mauritius
annotation.venue: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (MITCI) website
annotation.summary_en: Government news release on the April 2026 launch of Mauritius' National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines (Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness and Integrity, Responsibility), the AI Unit website and Regional AI Marketplace. It stresses innovation, skills and ethical AI use; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines launched for ethical, transparent AI adoption in Mauritius
AI Unit website and Regional AI Marketplace unveiled to connect providers, startups and institutions
Provisions being made to facilitate startup registration and safeguard the local AI industry
Linked to Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025–2029, with DIVA AI assistant for public services
